item.title: DHS shutdown tied for second-longest ever as Dems again block funding amid airport chaos, terrorism concerns
item.summary: A closed-door meeting with border czar Tom Homan signals possible movement in the 35-day DHS shutdown, even as Senate Democrats blocked another funding vote Friday.

item.title: Video captures US strike on suspected narco vessel in Eastern Pacific, Coast Guard searches for 3 survivors
item.summary: U.S. forces struck an alleged narco-trafficking vessel in the Eastern Pacific, leaving three survivors and no U.S. military casualties reported.

item.title: Trump administration sues Harvard over alleged failure to protect Jewish and Israeli students, seeks billions
item.summary: The Trump administration is suing Harvard, alleging it failed to protect Jewish students from antisemitism and seeking billions in taxpayer funds back.

item.title: US intel finds no China plan to invade Taiwan by 2027, despite military buildup
item.summary: The U.S. intelligence community says China has no fixed timeline to invade Taiwan and is not planning action by 2027, marking a shift from prior warnings.

item.title: Reporter's Notebook: GOP pushes election security bill despite slim odds, as Trump pressure looms
item.summary: Senate Republicans debate the SAVE America Act despite lacking votes, as Trump threatens to withhold endorsements from GOP members who oppose the bill.

item.title: Fox News Campus Radicals Newsletter: College GOP chapter sues school, leaked docs expose union extremism
item.summary: Stay up to date with the Fox News Campus Radicals newsletter, which brings you the in-depth investigative stories from college campuses nationwide.

item.title: Trump signs executive order blocking college football games from competing with Army-Navy time slot
item.summary: President Donald Trump signed the Preserving America's Game executive order, vowing to protect the Army-Navy game's time slot from College Football Playoff expansion.

item.title: Nancy Guthrie update: Investigators are looking into reports of suspicious activity in her neighborhood
item.summary: Pima County investigators are probing suspicious activity near Nancy Guthrie's home as DNA analysis continues 47 days after her suspected abduction.

item.title: Video shows mother of three confronting alleged squatters after finding two strangers naked in her bed
item.summary: A Chicago nursing student and mother of three says she found naked squatters in her bed, leaving her traumatized and fearing for her family's safety.

item.title: Pritzker pushes prosecutions of Trump officials as part of Dem ‘Project 2029’ agenda
item.summary: Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker called for the criminal prosecution of Trump officials if Democrats win 2028, dubbing his Democratic policy blueprint Project 2029.
